name: KONE Expense Reimbursement (Universal Skill)
description: Universal, platform-neutral skill for KONE/通力 expense reimbursement: invoice field extraction, city-tier normalization, date-based aggregation, policy compliance checks with settlement options (cap_to_standard / claim_actual_with_reason), decision workflow, cross-run incremental dedup, and structured outputs (template-input.json / host-contract.json). The policy core (portable-core.mjs) is zero-dependency; the bundled template-adapter renders the official-template Excel (requires adm-zip).
author: REBU Team

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: JSON file conforming to PortableSkillInput schema: employee profile + invoice list with rawText/emailSubject/fileName/preParsed

inputs.name: decisions
inputs.description: JSON file with user decisions answering review questions (DecisionInput[] schema)

outputs.name: summary
outputs.description: Human-readable processing summary with actual/reimbursable totals, policy status, and next steps

outputs.name: reimbursement-draft
outputs.description: Structured draft with extracted fields, statuses, aggregation groups, actual and reimbursable totals

outputs.name: policy-report
outputs.description: Policy compliance check results per invoice

outputs.name: policy-findings
outputs.description: Policy findings with explicit confirmation requirements

outputs.name: review-questions
outputs.description: Human-readable review questions for items needing confirmation

outputs.name: review-questions-structured
outputs.description: Machine-readable review questions with settlement options and amount impact

outputs.name: review-decisions.template
outputs.description: Pre-filled decision template for users to complete and pass back via --decisions

outputs.name: decision-log
outputs.description: Audit log of applied decisions (only present when --decisions supplied)

outputs.name: template-input
outputs.description: Structured data with contractVersion for host Excel rendering; limited categories aggregated by date, transport per-ticket

outputs.name: host-contract
outputs.description: Versioned logical template contract defining header, detail row types, and field semantics. No physical template, cell coordinates, or OOXML. Host adapter maps to authorized template.

outputs.name: audit
outputs.description: Append-only audit trail of all processing actions

outputs.name: output-manifest
outputs.description: OutputManifest containing skill/policy/host-contract versions, relative file refs, and SHA-256 hashes

hostResponsibilities: PDF/OFD/XML file parsing and text extraction
Rendering custom documents from template-input.json / host-contract.json (the bundled template-adapter already renders the official-template Excel via bundle.mjs)

distribution.notice: Public package: policy + organization + review + structured outputs + official-template Excel rendering. Bundled with one official reimbursement template and the template adapter. Internal policy PDFs and backend code are not included.
